title: coap_status.c fails to compile against pinned Zephyr v3.7.0 (blocks puck + ping_l2 builds)
description: While validating bead 1m92 on the AWS v3.7.0 builder (worktree /mnt/lichen-zephyr/work/1m92-validate, base 730d03cd lineage), lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_status.c fails with -Werror: (1) static assertions at gcc.h:87 'LICHEN_COAP_STATUS_CBOR_MAX_SIZE must fit in CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE' plus NEIGHBORS and ROUTES variants; (2) coap_status.c:475 -Werror=switch-enum: enumeration value LICHEN_COAP_TRUST_UNKNOWN not handled in switch. This breaks: west build -b t1000_e/nrf52840 lichen/apps/puck and west build -b native_sim lichen/tests/ping_l2 on the pinned Zephyr. Drivers (bead 1m92) are unaffected and validated. Note: another worker has uncommitted coap/Kconfig + CMakeLists changes in the local tree that may already address part of this.
